import os, sys, time, signal
n = int(sys.argv[1])
kids = []
err = None
for i in range(n):
    try:
        pid = os.fork()
    except OSError as exc:
        err = repr(exc)
        break
    if pid == 0:
        time.sleep(60)
        os._exit(0)
    kids.append(pid)
print('forked', len(kids), flush=True)
print('fork_error', err, flush=True)
for pid in kids:
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    os.waitpid(pid, 0)
print('alive_after', True, flush=True)
